deltas.subject: CoAllPeriodicTable+ as a receiver-relative multidimensional relational projection rather than a literal table of indivisible substances
tests: treat element atomicity as projection-relative usefulness, not metaphysical indivisibility
represent a 2D table as one projection of higher-dimensional relation space including receiver, context, valid time, provenance, and bounded recursion depth
permit 3D plus CoTime+ trajectories without making position equal identity
project one candidate element through CoPriMath+ and CoGibberTru+ with explicit projection-loss accounting
permit relations-about-elements and relations-about-relations while bounding traversal and materialization
challenge whether periodicity or neighborhood structure yields useful predictive or navigational value rather than decorative analogy
deltas.expected_benefit: Provide a compact navigable projection for reusable relational primitives while preserving receiver-relative meaning, CoTime+, provenance, projection loss, and bounded meta-relations.
risks: periodic-table imagery can falsely imply scientific validation, fixed ontology, or natural periodic law
atomic language can be mistaken for literal indivisibility
high-dimensional relation space can become decorative complexity without measurable navigation or reasoning benefit
recursive relations can create traversal explosion if every possible meta-relation is materialized
wake_conditions: a stronger existing periodic or element-like relational model is exact-bound
a bounded visual or machine-readable projection canary is proposed
CoPriMath+ or CoGibberTru+ receiver requires an explicit multidimensional element projection
collision or ambiguity is found with an existing CoLex+ symbol family

deltas.subject: Fu as a candidate symbolic CoMythOps+ relational element within CoAllPeriodicTable+
tests: search CoLex+/GIBindex lineage for symbol collision before any canonical binding
retain MYTHIC typing across human, machine, CoPriMath+, and CoGibberTru+ projections
demonstrate at least one useful typed bond or neighborhood relation involving Fu without treating the relation as factual evidence
test receiver-relative renderings in 2D, 3D, and CoTime+ trajectory views
bound recursive use so Fu may participate in meta-relations without requiring unbounded turtles
deltas.expected_benefit: Create a memorable compact handle for a mythic, metaphorical, symbolic, and meaning-bearing relational projection while keeping its epistemic and authority boundaries explicit.
risks: Fu may collide with an existing symbol, acronym, term, or culturally loaded meaning
symbolic compactness may be mistaken for scientific status or semantic completeness
mythic potency can be confused with operational mechanism or factual claim
wake_conditions: a receiver canary demonstrates lower projection cost or better recall using Fu
a CoAllPeriodicTable+ schema or visual prototype is available for bounded placement
a contradiction shows Fu should be renamed, split, or remain only an alias
deltas.next_receiver: CoLex+/CoMythOps+ symbolic collision and projection review
